Product / Series: 10 oz Poured Silver Bar (Legacy Ingots - Multiple Series)
Key Hallmarks & Design Features (Use for: Obverse typically features 'ENGELHARD' in rectangular/oval stamp with sunburst or radial lines design; weight stamp '10.000' or '10 OZ'; purity '999+' or '.999 FINE SILVER'; serial number below (often 4-6 digits, various prefixes like P for Plainville plant, C for Carteret). Early examples more crudely hand-stamped/poured with irregular edges. Reverse often plain or repeating logo pattern on later production. Many stamping/font variations across series (e.g., 7th, 10th, 11th series).
Authentication Tips & Variations: Weigh precisely (should be very close to 10.000 oz). Inspect stamp quality and consistency with known examples. Early poured bars have artisanal character vs later machine-pressed. Check allengelhard.com for definitive series ID by prefix/serial range. Counterfeits exist on popular sizes — buy authenticated or from trusted sources.
Collectibility / Notes: HIGHLY COLLECTIBLE vintage US bullion. Premium over spot for nice examples, especially rarer early series or low-mintage varieties. Iconic 'trusted bullion' of its era.

Product / Series: The American Prospector 1 oz Silver Round
Key Hallmarks & Design Features (Use for: OBVERSE: Prospector kneeling/panning gold in stream, 'U.S.A.' left, year right, 'THE AMERICAN PROSPECTOR' curved bottom. REVERSE: Bald eagle with arrows & olive branch, 'ENGELHARD' top, 'ONE TROY OUNCE 999+ FINE SILVER' curved bottom. Beaded border both sides. Clean, high-relief strike typical of later issues.
Authentication Tips & Variations: Match design exactly to photos. Check edge reeding and weight. Serial numbers not always present on rounds. Popular and relatively available but genuine examples hold collector interest.
Collectibility / Notes: Popular collectible round from Engelhard's first public bullion round series. Good entry point for Engelhard collectors.

Product / Series: 10 oz Silver Bar (JM & Successor)
Key Hallmarks & Design Features (Use for: JM era: 'JOHNSON MATTHEY' or 'JM' logo with crossed hammers in diamond; 'ASSAYERS & REFINERS'; weight/purity/serial stamps; often 'U.S.A.' or plant location (e.g., Salt Lake City). Asahi era: Updated 'Asahi SLC' oval or similar hallmarks, continued high quality. Clean, professional stamping.
Authentication Tips & Variations: Verify logo/hallmark matches era. JM crossed hammers is classic. Asahi continues the legacy with modern consistency. Good Delivery bars also produced.
Collectibility / Notes: Reliable, widely recognized refiner. JM vintage bars have collector following; Asahi modern production is stacker-friendly with low premiums.

Product / Series: American Silver Eagle 1 oz Bullion Coin (Type 1 & Type 2)
Key Hallmarks & Design Features (Use for: OBVERSE (both types): Walking Liberty (Weinman design) striding with branches, sun rays rising, 'LIBERTY' arched, 'IN GOD WE TRUST', year at bottom. REVERSE Type 1 (1986-2021): Heraldic eagle with shield, arrows & olive, 'UNITED STATES OF AMERICA' '1 OZ. FINE SILVER - ONE DOLLAR'. REVERSE Type 2 (2021+): Soaring bald eagle with olive branch, similar legends. Reeded edge; modern issues have enhanced security features (micro-grooves, etc.). Bullion versions typically no mint mark.
Authentication Tips & Variations: Compare reverse design for Type 1 vs 2. Check weight (~1.000 oz), diameter (40.6mm), and edge. Fakes exist but modern security helps. Edge lettering on some later issues.
Collectibility / Notes: Most popular and liquid US silver bullion coin. Type 2 has modern appeal. Low premiums; easy to buy/sell. Great for stacking or as gift.

Product / Series: 1 oz Silver Rounds (Buffalo, Eagle & Custom Designs)
Key Hallmarks & Design Features (Use for: Varies by design but typically crisp strikes with private mint marks. Common: 'SUNSHINE MINT' or 'SMI' hallmark, '1 TROY OZ .999 FINE SILVER', Buffalo or American Eagle motifs, or custom private labels. High quality, mirror-like fields on some.
Authentication Tips & Variations: Weight and diameter check. Look for consistent mint mark and sharp details. Reputable private mint with good reputation for quality and authenticity.
Collectibility / Notes: Affordable, attractive modern bullion rounds. Excellent for stacking; popular designs like Buffalo appeal to collectors too. Low premiums.

Product / Series: American Gold Eagle 1 oz Bullion Coin
Key Hallmarks & Design Features (Use for: OBVERSE: Augustus Saint-Gaudens Liberty striding with torch & olive branch, 'LIBERTY' arched top, year bottom. REVERSE: Family of eagles (male flying with olive, female with hatchling), 'UNITED STATES OF AMERICA' '1 OZ. FINE GOLD' '50 DOLLARS'. Reeded edge. Iconic, high-relief design.
Authentication Tips & Variations: 22k alloy (copper/silver) for durability — slightly different color than pure gold. Weigh ~1.0909 oz gross for 1 oz fine. Fakes exist; buy from authorized dealers or authenticate high-value pieces.
Collectibility / Notes: Flagship US gold bullion coin. Highly liquid worldwide. Premium over spot reflects 22k and popularity. Fractional sizes available for smaller investments.

Product / Series: American Buffalo 1 oz Bullion Coin
Key Hallmarks & Design Features (Use for: OBVERSE: Native American (profile inspired by Buffalo Nickel), 'LIBERTY' top, year, 'IN GOD WE TRUST'. REVERSE: American Bison standing, 'UNITED STATES OF AMERICA' '1 OZ. .9999 FINE GOLD' '$50'. Classic, bold design with high relief.
Authentication Tips & Variations: Pure .9999 gold — different color/weight feel from AGE. Check design match and weight precisely. Popular alternative for those preferring pure gold.
Collectibility / Notes: Pure gold version of iconic Buffalo design. Strong collector and investor appeal. Good diversification from 22k AGE.

Product / Series: 1 oz Gold Bar or Prospector Round (Vintage)
Key Hallmarks & Design Features (Use for: Similar hallmark style to silver counterparts: 'ENGELHARD' logo/stamp, weight '1 OZ' or 'ONE TROY OUNCE', purity, serial. Prospector round version uses same design as silver Prospector. Simple, elegant vintage stamping.
Authentication Tips & Variations: Rarer than silver Engelhard pieces. Verify hallmarks and weight. Often found in secondary market with collector premium.
Collectibility / Notes: Vintage US gold Engelhard is scarcer and prized by collectors. Nice complement to silver Prospector rounds.

Product / Series: 1 oz Platinum Prospector Round or Bar
Key Hallmarks & Design Features (Use for: Prospector design (same as silver/gold versions) or simple bar with 'ENGELHARD' hallmark, '1 TROY OUNCE', '999.5 FINE PLATINUM', serial. Clean but less ornate than modern Swiss platinum.
Authentication Tips & Variations: Platinum bullion from this era is uncommon. Confirm purity stamp and weight (platinum is dense). Engelhard was historically a top platinum refiner ('Platinum King').
Collectibility / Notes: Rare vintage platinum from major US refiner. Strong historical appeal for PGM collectors.

Product / Series: American Platinum Eagle 1 oz Bullion Coin
Period / Years: 1997-2008 (initial), then intermittent years (e.g. 2014+ with new designs)
Key Hallmarks & Design Features (Use for: Designs vary by era/year: Early issues had Statue of Liberty or specific eagle motifs; later resumed with updated eagle designs. Obverse often features Lady Liberty or similar; reverse soaring or heraldic eagle. 'UNITED STATES OF AMERICA' '1 OZ. PLATINUM' '$100'. Reeded edge.
Authentication Tips & Variations: Mintage can be low in some years — check US Mint production figures. Authenticate via design specifics and weight. Less liquid than gold/silver but excellent for portfolio diversification.
Collectibility / Notes: Official US platinum bullion coin. Good for those wanting sovereign platinum exposure. Varies in availability by year.

Product / Series: 1 oz Lady Fortuna Gold Bar (Minted)
Key Hallmarks & Design Features (Use for: OBVERSE: Beautiful Lady Fortuna profile (Roman goddess of fortune) with cornucopia/flowers in hair, flowing design, often 'LADY FORTUNA' or anniversary text (e.g. 45th). REVERSE: 'PAMP SUISSE' 'ONE TROY OUNCE 999.9 FINE GOLD' serial number, 'SWISS MADE', PAMP logo (stylized 3-circle or flower motif), assay stamp/certificate number. Usually sealed in assay card with signed cert from assayer.
Authentication Tips & Variations: Iconic artistic design — easy to recognize. Check serial matches cert, assay hologram/security features on card. Swiss quality and reputation are top-tier. Many limited editions exist.
Collectibility / Notes: World-class Swiss bullion with artistic appeal. Fortuna design is globally recognized and highly desirable. Excellent liquidity and collector premium on some editions.

Product / Series: 1 oz or 10 oz Lady Fortuna Silver Bar
Key Hallmarks & Design Features (Use for: Same elegant Lady Fortuna obverse design as gold version (scaled appropriately). Reverse: 'PAMP SUISSE' hallmarks, weight, purity '.999 FINE SILVER', serial, 'SWISS MADE', logo. Often in assay packaging.
Authentication Tips & Variations: Matches gold Fortuna for set building. Same high-quality Swiss minting standards and security features.
Collectibility / Notes: Artistic Swiss silver bullion to complement gold or for pure silver stacking with beauty. Lower premiums than some vintage US pieces.

Product / Series: 10 oz Silver Stacker Bar
Key Hallmarks & Design Features (Use for: Obverse: Prominent crowned lion head (Scottsdale Mint logo/crest) in center, 'Scottsdale Silver' arched or below, '.999 Fine Silver' '10 Troy Ounces', 'IN GOD WE TRUST' near bottom. Unique rectangular 'stacker' shape with grooved or interlocking side edges designed for stable stacking. Often brushed/satin finish with crisp modern stamping. Reverse: Usually plain or subtle repeating pattern; some issues have security features.
Authentication Tips & Variations: Distinctive lion/crown hallmark + stackable shape makes it easy to ID. Weigh precisely (10.000 oz). Scottsdale is one of the most popular modern US private mints for quality and design. Check edge grooves and stamp consistency. Low premiums, widely available.
Collectibility / Notes: EXTREMELY popular modern USA silver bullion bar — a top seller on APMEX and US dealers for stacking. Attractive heraldic design appeals to both investors and collectors. Easy to stack and store.

Product / Series: 1 oz Silver Round (various popular designs, e.g. Buffalo or generic)
Key Hallmarks & Design Features (Use for: Varies by specific design but typically: Obverse with Scottsdale lion/crown or popular motif (Buffalo, Morgan-style, or custom), 'Scottsdale Mint' or 'Scottsdale Silver', weight/purity. Reverse: Matching or complementary design, '1 TROY OZ .999 FINE SILVER', often with 'IN GOD WE TRUST' or mint mark. High-relief, clean strikes with excellent detail. Many limited or themed editions exist.
Authentication Tips & Variations: Match specific design to photos/listings. Consistent high-quality minting from Scottsdale. Weight ~1.000 oz, sharp edges/reeding. Popular for variety and low premiums.
Collectibility / Notes: Very popular on APMEX for affordable, attractive 1 oz silver rounds. Wide range of designs keeps it interesting for collectors while remaining great for stacking. Easy to buy/sell.

Product / Series: 10 oz Silver Bar (with MintMark SI security feature)
Key Hallmarks & Design Features (Use for: Obverse: Often features eagle or 'SUNSHINE MINTING' logo with sunburst, weight '.999 FINE SILVER 10 OUNCES'. Reverse: Frequently includes the distinctive 'MINTMARK SI' security feature (a raised or micro-detailed dot/pattern area for authentication, often circular with radiating lines or text). Clean, professional stamping with high detail. Some designs have diagonal sunburst patterns.
Authentication Tips & Variations: Look for the MintMark SI security feature on reverse or designated area — it's a key anti-counterfeit element Sunshine is known for. Weigh accurately. Sharp details and consistent quality. Popular low-premium bar.
Collectibility / Notes: Highly popular modern USA silver bullion on APMEX and dealers. The MintMark SI adds authentication confidence. Great for stacking; clean design appeals broadly.

Product / Series: 1 oz Silver Round (various designs)
Key Hallmarks & Design Features (Use for: Varies by design (often Morgan dollar style, Buffalo, or generic eagle/liberty motifs). Typically includes 'Golden State Mint' or 'GSM' hallmark, '1 TROY OZ .999 FINE SILVER', year or design-specific text. Clean strikes with good detail and reeded or plain edges depending on issue. Affordable, no-frills popular rounds.
Authentication Tips & Variations: Match design elements and hallmark. Golden State Mint is a well-known US producer of affordable bullion rounds. Weight check and sharp minting are reliable indicators. Very common in secondary market.
Collectibility / Notes: One of the most popular low-premium 1 oz silver rounds available via APMEX and US dealers. Excellent for bulk stacking while still having attractive designs. High liquidity.

Product / Series: Modern 1 oz or 10 oz Silver Bars & Rounds (JM legacy continuation)
Period / Years: 2015+ (Asahi acquisition of JM US ops) - present
Key Hallmarks & Design Features (Use for: Clean modern hallmarks: Often 'ASAHI' or 'Asahi SLC' (Salt Lake City) in oval or updated logo, crossed hammers or refined JM-style elements in some issues, weight, '.999 FINE SILVER', serial on bars. Professional, consistent stamping. Some products carry forward Johnson Matthey quality standards under new ownership. Reverse often plain or subtle pattern.
Authentication Tips & Variations: Asahi continues the reputable JM US refining tradition. Look for updated SLC/Asahi marks vs older JM crossed hammers. Weigh and inspect stamp quality. Reliable modern production with Good Delivery heritage.
Collectibility / Notes: Popular modern USA silver from a major refiner (successor to Johnson Matthey US). Low premiums, trusted quality. Good bridge between vintage JM and current production. Widely available on APMEX.

Product / Series: 1 oz Gold Bar (Lion / Certi-Lock / Marquee style)
Key Hallmarks & Design Features (Use for: Obverse: Prominent crowned lion head (Scottsdale Mint crest/logo), 'Scottsdale Gold', weight/purity stamps (e.g., '1 TROY OUNCE 9999 FINE GOLD'). Collectibility / Notes: Popular modern USA gold bullion bar on APMEX. Attractive lion design parallels their popular silver Stacker bars. Good liquidity and collector appeal for the brand.

Product / Series: American Gold Eagle 1/10 oz Fractional Bullion Coin (and other fractionals)
Period / Years: 1986 - present (random year or specific dates like 2026)
Key Hallmarks & Design Features (Use for: Same iconic designs as the 1 oz AGE: OBVERSE - Saint-Gaudens Liberty with torch, 'LIBERTY', year. REVERSE - Family of eagles, 'UNITED STATES OF AMERICA', weight/purity/face value scaled (e.g., '$5' for 1/10 oz). Reeded edge. Smaller size but identical artwork and 22k alloy for durability. Very common 'random year' or tube packaging on APMEX.
Authentication Tips & Variations: Design matches larger AGE exactly (just scaled). Weigh ~0.1091 oz gross for 1/10 oz fine. Popular entry-level gold coin. Fakes exist on popular sizes — buy from authorized dealers or check security features on modern issues. Easy to stack in tubes.
Collectibility / Notes: One of the most popular affordable gold bullion coins on APMEX. Great for starting or adding to a gold position without committing to full 1 oz. High liquidity and recognition worldwide.

Product / Series: 1 oz Gold Bar or CombiBar (segmentable)
Common Weights: 1 oz (CombiBar often 50x1g or similar divisible formats)
Key Hallmarks & Design Features (Use for: Clean Swiss hallmarks: 'VALCAMBI SUISSE' or 'Valcambi', weight, '.9999 FINE GOLD', serial. CombiBar version has pre-scored segments that can be broken into smaller gram pieces (unique divisible feature). Often in assay card. Simple, elegant, professional minting with high consistency. Some have 'CombiBar' branding or grid lines.
Authentication Tips & Variations: Valcambi is a top-tier Swiss refiner (LBMA approved). Look for clean stamping and assay packaging. The CombiBar's break-apart design is a key identifier and practical feature for divisibility. Weigh accurately.
Collectibility / Notes: Very popular on APMEX for quality Swiss gold with the innovative CombiBar option for flexibility. Excellent liquidity and trusted brand alongside PAMP.

Product / Series: 1 oz Gold Bar (Classic / in Assay)
Key Hallmarks & Design Features (Use for: Obverse: 'Credit Suisse' text or logo, weight/purity stamps (e.g. '1 oz Fine Gold 999.9'), serial number. Often features a simple elegant design or bank emblem. Comes in tamper-evident assay card with certificate/serial match on many issues. Clean, professional Swiss minting quality. Reverse usually plain or confirmatory stamps.
Authentication Tips & Variations: Look for Credit Suisse branding and assay packaging (tamper-evident is common on modern). Serial on bar should match assay. Trusted classic Swiss bank-backed bar — very frequently listed on APMEX gold pages alongside PAMP and US Mint. Weigh precisely.
Collectibility / Notes: One of the most popular and recognizable classic gold bars on APMEX. Excellent liquidity, strong reputation, and often available in assay. Great addition to a 'one of everything' gold collection.

Product / Series: 1 oz Silver Bar (Classic / in Assay)
Key Hallmarks & Design Features (Use for: Obverse: 'Credit Suisse' branding or logo, weight/purity, serial. Often in tamper-evident assay card. Clean Swiss quality with bank backing. Reverse usually confirmatory or plain. Classic elegant design.
Authentication Tips & Variations: Look for Credit Suisse marks and assay packaging (serial match common). Trusted classic alongside PAMP. Weigh accurately. Frequently appears on APMEX silver pages.
Collectibility / Notes: Popular classic Swiss silver bar on APMEX. Good liquidity and recognition. Complements the Credit Suisse gold bar for a matched pair in collections.

Product / Series: 1 oz Gold Bar (Generic / TEP / Secondary)
Key Hallmarks & Design Features (Use for: Varies by refiner but typically clean stamped hallmarks (weight, .9999 Fine Gold, serial or refiner mark). Often in tamper-evident packaging (TEP) or simple assay. No fancy artwork — practical stacker bar. Reverse usually plain or basic confirmation.
Authentication Tips & Variations: Focus on weight, purity stamp, and packaging integrity. These are the affordable, high-volume generic bars many APMEX buyers choose for stacking. Quality depends on the actual refiner (often Valcambi, PAMP, or Asahi lineage).
Collectibility / Notes: Extremely common low-premium option on APMEX gold pages. Great for 'one of everything' when you want volume without high premiums. Easy to add to any collection.

Product / Series: 1 oz Silver Bar or Round (Generic / Popular designs)
Key Hallmarks & Design Features (Use for: Varies widely — often Buffalo, Morgan, or generic eagle/liberty designs on rounds; clean stamped bars with weight/.999 Fine Silver. Many have 'APMEX' branding or are secondary market. High liquidity, low premiums. Some have basic security features.
Authentication Tips & Variations: Match design to photos/listings. These are the everyday stacker items. Weight and basic hallmarks are reliable. Very common in tubes or bulk on APMEX silver pages.
Collectibility / Notes: The most common affordable silver items on APMEX. Perfect for bulk stacking and filling out a 'one of everything' collection without high cost.

Product / Series: Fractional Silver Rounds (1/10 oz, 1/4 oz, 1/2 oz popular sizes)
Key Hallmarks & Design Features (Use for: Often feature classic U.S. coin designs scaled down (Mercury Dime, Standing Liberty, Walking Liberty, Buffalo, etc.). Clean strikes with '1/10 oz .999 Fine Silver' or similar stamps. Many come in TEP or tubes. High detail for small size.
Authentication Tips & Variations: Match the specific design (e.g., Mercury Dime style). Weigh precisely for the fraction. These are excellent entry-level or gift items and very common on APMEX fractional silver sections.
Collectibility / Notes: Highly popular on APMEX for affordable silver exposure. Great way to collect 'one of everything' across sizes while keeping costs reasonable. Many designs tie back to historic U.S. coins.

Product / Series: American Platinum Eagle 1 oz Bullion Coin
Period / Years: 1997-2008 + intermittent later years (designs vary by era)
Key Hallmarks & Design Features (Use for: Designs change by year/series: Early issues often featured Statue of Liberty or specific eagle motifs; later years have updated eagle designs. Obverse typically Liberty or eagle theme; reverse soaring or heraldic eagle. 'UNITED STATES OF AMERICA', '1 OZ. PLATINUM', '$100'. Reeded edge. Mintage varies (some years low).
Authentication Tips & Variations: Check specific year/design against US Mint archives or photos. Weight ~1.000 oz fine. Platinum bullion is less common than gold/silver — authenticity via design details and reputable sourcing is key. Lower liquidity than gold/silver.
Collectibility / Notes: The main official US platinum bullion coin and a core item for anyone collecting 'one of everything' from APMEX platinum pages. Good for portfolio diversification.

Product / Series: 1 oz Platinum Bar (Fortuna or similar)
Key Hallmarks & Design Features (Use for: Similar elegant style to PAMP gold/silver Fortuna bars: Lady Fortuna or clean design on obverse, 'PAMP SUISSE', weight, '.9995 FINE PLATINUM', serial, Swiss Made, assay features. High-quality Swiss minting with security elements on assay card.
Authentication Tips & Variations: Match the Fortuna or specific PAMP design. Assay card and serial matching are standard. PAMP is a top-tier refiner for platinum as well as gold/silver. Weigh accurately.
Collectibility / Notes: Popular high-quality Swiss platinum bar on APMEX. Complements PAMP gold/silver Fortuna sets nicely for a matched collection across metals.
